caption: The drawing consists of two main objects on an off-white background. At the top center, there is a small and simple pencil sketch of an object resembling a decorative handle, possibly for a vessel or staff, which is vertically oriented and includes scale markings labeled "scale of inches" below it. The object has a rounded, bulbous middle section and a flat, wider top. Below this sketch, in the lower half of the drawing, there is a detailed colored circular object centered inside a rectangular frame. This circle features an ornate bronze or brown outer design with floral or scrollwork patterns, and a central oval with a pink or purple relief of a profile portrait, possibly of a helmeted figure. The circular object is labeled below it with faint text that appears to read "High Bronze". The drawing overall employs a combination of pencil and colored medium for accuracy and detail.
title: Curtain Tie-back
